name: Automatic Complete Ticket Delivery
goal: Automatically deliver every issued ticket unit for WhatsApp orders through durable PostgreSQL intents and provider-attempt audit records.
conversation_authority: sales_orders.sales_conversation_id exact FK and matching buyer phone
issuance_handoff: ticket_issued transition and TicketDeliveryCoordinatorWorker insertion commit together
pagination: bounded id-ordered keyset pages of 50 with per-page intent and job transactions
migration_scope: Create sales_ticket_delivery_intents, link per-attempt delivery audit rows, add correctness unique identities and required indexes, extend delivery_reason contract; down migration refuses to destroy durable delivery evidence.
out_of_scope: P0-D revocation batching and purchase ceiling
